QuestInfo.name: Lucas's Reply
QuestInfo.parent: Please bring this letter to Lucas
QuestInfo.1: I delivered #b#t4031001##k to #b#p17##k in #b#m1010##k, and he wrote her a reply. I should bring it back to #b#p10##k now.
QuestInfo.2: #b#p10##k looked relieved after reading the reply from #b#p17##k. Now I want to read it too. Wonder what this was all about...

0.0: Ohhh, the letter from #b#p10##k! I was beginning to worry. Okay, here's the #breply letter#k. Head back to #b#p10##k and deliver it. Thanks.

no.0: Oh... Are you really busy? Sigh. This letter needs to be delivered right away...

1.0: Oh, the reply letter! Thank you! I want to give you something to show my appreciation.

yes.0: Ta da! A hat! It has a level limitation, but I think you're strong enough to wear it. Thanks again for all your help!
yes.1:
If you don't know how to equip items yet, open the #bEquip tab#k in your Inventory.
 You can freely switch between menus using the #bTab#k key. To equip an item, just #bdouble-click#k on it.
 To check if it's equipped properly, open the #bEquipment window#k.

npc.0: You didn't deliver my reply to #b#p10##k yet? If you lose my reply, just tell me. I suppose I can write up another one.

item.0: Have you not gone to the chief yet? Or did you lose the letter? Please deliver the letter soon and bring back Chief #b#p17#'s#k reply.

lost.0: You lost my reply letter? Bah, such carelessness! I have a town to run, you know. But fine, I'll rewrite the letter. Here, take it, and don't lose it this time.
